Thank you for testing HRIS. Positive, negative, mixed, and null results are all useful. Remove private or identifying information before submitting.

## AI system and model

Include the interface, model/version, and experiment date when known.

## Tasks and shorthand cue

Describe the original task, transfer task, and candidate shorthand cue.

## Procedure

Describe the history-conditioned and fresh-control conditions, number of trials, and any protocol changes.

## Overall outcome

Choose or describe: positive difference, null result, mixed/ambiguous result, or negative/contrary result.

## Observations and scores

Include constraint recovery, task fit, stability, and unprompted reconstruction when available.

## Alternative explanations and limitations

Consider wording, randomness, task familiarity, interface features, order effects, and evaluator expectations.

## Privacy confirmation

- [ ] I removed private, confidential, and identifying information that I do not have permission to publish.
